entries.title: Zechariah 12:1
segments: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, says the LORD, who stretches forth the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:2
segments: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling to all the peoples all around, and it shall also be against Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:3
segments: And in that day I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all peoples. All who lift it shall be slashed, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:4
segments: In that day, says the LORD, I will strike every horse with terror, and his rider with madness. And I will open My eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:5
segments: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The people of Jerusalem [shall be] my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:6
segments: In that day I will make the governors of Judah like a hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire among cut grain. And they shall devour all the peoples all around, on the right hand and on the left hand. And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her place, in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:7
segments: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the people of Jerusalem may not be magnified above Judah.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:8
segments: In that day the LORD shall defend around the people of Jerusalem. And it will be, he who is feeble among them at that day [shall be] like David; and the house of David [shall be] like God, like the Angel of the LORD before them.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:9
segments: And it shall be in that day I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:10
segments: And I will pour on the house of David, and on the people of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of prayers. And they shall look on Me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for Him, as one mourns for his only [son], and shall be bitter over Him, as the bitterness over the first-born.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:11
segments: In that day shall be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

entries.title: Zechariah 12:12
segments: And the land shall mourn, each family apart; the family of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart

entries.title: Zechariah 12:13
segments: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

entries.title: Zechariah 12:14
segments: all the families who remain, each family apart and their wives apart.
